title: Wide-stop scaling gentler: $800 x square root of 20/stop
question: How much less should a wide stop risk? Full $800 up to a reference stop, less beyond it.
notes: risk = $800 x (20/stop)^0.5 beyond 20 pts (live: power 1). Method: post-hoc re-sizing of the baseline replay (exact engine micros).
method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
